description: Choose the items on one checkout step of a submitted application, replacing that step's previous choice. Item ids come from get_checkout; an empty list clears an optional step. Returns the updated cart.

application_id.description: The application's id (obs_…), from list_applications or start_application.

interval.description: Billing interval, for steps that offer a choice.

item_ids.description: Item ids from get_checkout for this step.

name: choose_package
title: Choose a package
